_description: Cross-implementation test fixtures for diff chunking. Each case defines a raw diff string, a max_bytes_per_chunk budget, and assertions about the resulting chunks.

cases.name: two_small_files_fit_one_chunk
cases.diff:
diff --git a/a.ts b/a.ts
-removed
diff --git a/b.ts b/b.ts
+added

cases.name: deletion_sections_prioritised_first
cases.diff:
diff --git a/new.ts b/new.ts
+++ b/new.ts
+export class NewThing {}
diff --git a/removed.ts b/removed.ts
--- a/removed.ts
+++ b/removed.ts
-export function removed() {}

cases.name: chunks_start_with_diff_header
cases.diff:
diff --git a/a.ts b/a.ts
-removed line
diff --git a/b.ts b/b.ts
+added line
diff --git a/c.ts b/c.ts
+another added
